mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightening condition defined by UNRATE falling below 5.0% signals robust employment growth and rising consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 and rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 570 signals economic sector diversification, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95 and HOUST > 570.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising housing market activity (HOUST) signals sustained consumer demand momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion with HOUST rising.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL inflation exceeding 2.5% annually signals potential monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 130,000 thousand persons indicates strong labor market conditions supporting consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 390,000 million dollars and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 9.2% signals robust consumer demand and labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 390000 and UNRATE < 9.2.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO below 90), corporate profit growth faces headwinds, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 90.
